replacement: “Well, I wouldn’t care to be in his shoes,” Rakitin hissed.
“Well, you won’t be, Rakitin. You’ll never be in his shoes. You shall black my shoes, Rakitin. That’s where you belong. You’ll never get a woman like me ... and he won’t either, perhaps ...”

“Don’t taunt me about dressing up, Rakitin. You don’t know everything that’s in my heart! If I choose to tear off my finery, I’ll tear it off at once, this minute,” she cried in a ringing voice. “You don’t know what that finery is for, Rakitin! Perhaps I’ll see him and say, ‘Have you ever seen me look like this before?’ He left me a thin, consumptive crybaby of seventeen. I’ll sit beside him, fascinate him and work him up. ‘Do you see what I’m like now?’ I’ll say to him. ‘Well, that’s all you’re getting, my dear sir. There’s many a slip between the cup and the lip!’ That may be what the finery is for, Rakitin.” Grushenka finished with a spiteful laugh. “I’m violent and I hold grudges, Alyosha. I’ll tear off my finery, I’ll destroy my beauty, I’ll scorch my face, slash it with a knife, and turn beggar. If I choose, I won’t go anywhere now to see anyone. If I choose, I’ll send Kuzma back everything he has ever given me, tomorrow, and all his money, and I’ll go out scrubbing floors for the rest of my life. You think I wouldn’t do it, Rakitin? That I wouldn’t dare? I would, I would, I could do it right now, only don’t push me ... and I’ll send him about his business, I’ll snap my fingers in his face, and he’ll never see me again!”
“_Jesus said to her, Woman, what has it to do with you or me? Mine hour is not yet come._

“We are rejoicing,” the little, thin old man went on. “We are drinking the new wine, the wine of a new and great gladness. Do you see how many guests there are? Here are the bride and the bridegroom, and here is the wise governor of the feast, tasting the new wine. Why are you surprised to see me? I gave an onion to a beggar, and so I am here, too. And many here have given just one onion each, only one little onion.... What are all our deeds? And you, my gentle one, you, my kind boy, you also knew how to give an onion to a starving woman today. Begin your work, dear one, begin it, gentle one!... Do you see our Sun? Do you see Him?”
